title: Latent panic: companion create helpers deserialize JSON built from unchecked Id::from values
description: ibyi sweep: create_space_file_tree (chat-filenode-server), create_space_task_list (chat-tasks-server), projected_node / projected_edge (graph-projection-server) build objects as JSON and deserialize with .expect('always deserializes'). Id's Deserialize validates but Id::from(&str) does not, so a non-RFC-8620 id (passed in or backend-assigned) panics. Return an error (serverFail) instead of panicking, and add a test with an invalid id; then remove the # Panics notes.
